subject: Inconsistent SNP Numbers in DART Package

messages.author: ce55d031c04cbd0d
messages.subject: Inconsistent SNP Numbers in DART Package
parts:
Hello admin,

I am attempting to filter the SNP dataset using certain parameters in the dart package. However, when I run the same parameters for the second time using the same dataset, it appears to have different SNP numbers. Is this a usual occurrence, or is there a problem in my filtering process?

messages.author: 9e12eec50c435b60
messages.subject: Re: [dartR] Inconsistent SNP Numbers in DART Package
parts:
Hi Nurul,

Some of the filters have a random element to them. For example, gl.filter.secondaries will filter out all but one SNP on sequence tags with multiple SNPs, and it picks the one to retain at random (by default).

This will affect the outcome of subsequent filtering, and so the number of retained SNPs will vary from run to run (albeit only slightly).

I expect that is the reason.

Arthur
